name: Crown&Sword
short_description: Crown & Sword is an epic 2D tactical Action RPG that combines base management, army building, and wave survival elements. You must manage your time in a dynamic day/night cycle, fortify your kingdom, and fight shoulder to shoulder against the relentless swarms that awaken when the sun sets.
reasons: 成長/積み上げ要素: RPG +10

name: Onmyoji: Soul Legend
short_description: Onmyoji: Soul Legend is a strategy card game inspired by onmyoji folklore. Build your deck, command shikigami, and face yokai and oni bosses through solo story battles, roguelike trials, and tactical card combat.
reasons: 成長/積み上げ要素: Roguelike +10

name: Farewells clicker
short_description: Farewells Clicker is an addictive blend of clicker and city builder! Expand your island, develop your city, and produce resources endlessly. Upgrade your buildings and skills through a vast skill tree to progress further and further!
reasons: 成長/積み上げ要素: Skill Tree +15
現在プレイヤー100人以上 +8

name: Worm In Rotating Land
short_description: Third part of worm adventures and walking simulation and survival game as player worm and mission to find stars and avoid falling to water. So be brave worm and try to find all stars

name: Crownhold
short_description: Noble Rulers — grow your realm and expand your castle in this short incremental game! Manage resources, discover foreign lands and build up an army to lay siege to your enemies.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー500人以上 +10

name: Apple Faces Up
short_description: Alter the inscribed laws and unravel mysteries with knowledge and wisdom. Welcome to the Infinite Library, where all past, present, and future phenomena are recorded. As the one with the power to rewrite these books, you must face 13 trials bestowed by the angel Mimir.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー10人以上 +5

name: 末日战姬：废土觉醒
short_description: 全球華人專屬！末日廢墟×日系萌娘，打造你的最強戰姬軍團！這是一款獸娘，機械妹，克蘇魯，福利拉滿的美少女養成策略卡牌遊戲！
reasons: 現在プレイヤー10人以上 +5

name: Is That a Human Organ?
short_description: This is a horror-themed anomaly-hunting game. As a black market cargo inspector, you must carefully check each item to ensure it’s normal. Please note that when I say “cargo,” I’m referring to… organs.

name: Cartel
short_description: Become a cartel leader and rule the entire market! Multiplayer competition awaits you with the cartel.

name: Fall Queen
short_description: Fall Queen follows the story of the princess who waited, but was never rescued. Deciding to rescue herself, she descends the crumbling castle; every leap bringing her closer to freedom. This precision 2D platformer will both delight your intellect and have you cursing out loud at the challenge!
reasons: 現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: Dual Cat: Max
short_description: Lead Max, a clever cat with a brave heart, on a charming rescue adventure to bring his best friend, Erwin, home.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: SOVA NA SKAKALKE
short_description: It's all fun and games... until the Jump Rope Owl shows up.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: Tropical Hop
short_description: Get ready for a unique tropical survival adventure.

name: 演义三国
short_description: 《演义三国》是一款有独特三国味的国风策略卡牌游戏，采用了九宫格站位，技能吟唱施法的战斗方式。在这您将要招募良将组成梦幻队伍挑战风格迥异的三国名将。
reasons: 現在プレイヤー10人以上 +5

name: Percorso - The Retraced Steps
short_description: Percorso is a minimalist logic puzzle game. Guide the hero through dynamic mazes to collect coins and visit every tile without retracing your steps. Master portals, ice, and traps across hundreds of levels. Includes an infinite mode and a level editor.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: Cat Meow-tilation
short_description: Become a U-O alien and gather as many cats as you can to save your home planet! A unique cat-capturing game themed around "Cats" × "Red Light, Green Light"!
reasons: 現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: The Leather Maker
short_description: Walk the wharves, meeting houses, taverns, and markets of colonial Boston. Converse with merchants, laborers, patriots, and notable gentlemen whose names shall echo through history. Seek counsel from allies, uncover hidden truths, and lend your voice to the great discussions of the age.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: Eggscape
short_description: You’re a chicken escaping the slaughter line. Find your stolen chicks and free your fellow chickens as you fight through the factory, and survive the hunt from workers and failed lab creations.

name: STEAM TRIGGER
short_description: Die, adapt, and strike back in a brutal steampunk Metroidvania. Explore a collapsing machine city and take down towering bosses in precise 2.5D combat.

name: 东方
short_description: "East" is a military-themed tower defense PC game. The game is based on the personal experiences of Guo Xiang from the novel as he participates in the Korean War, telling the story of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army fighting fearlessly to liberate Korea.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: Dave's Questions
short_description: A simple, quick, quiz game for 2-3 players! Come's with a built in question set, and the ability to easily create your own question sets from a .csv file! Ideal for a quick session with friends or family.

name: Echoes of the Deep : Incremental Endless Miner
short_description: Incremental Endless Miner . Delve into the depths of Mount Olympus. You are Constantine , a miner set to discover the mountains secrets .

name: Asobutsuri
short_description: Place items freely in a virtual space, harness the laws of physics, and build your own Rube Goldberg-style contraptions. Design your contraption, press the Action Button, and enjoy the thrill of watching it come to life. A built-in Stage Editor lets you create your own original stages.

name: Balls Up
short_description: Balls Up is a climbing game where players unlock abilities and choose different paths to ascend. Unlock permanent upgrades for your character, a ball. Face the constant risk of falling back to the start, exploring varied paths and abilities.

name: GameOverd
short_description: GameOverd is a retro-inspired precision platformer packed with deadly traps, handcrafted levels, and chaotic boss fights. Learn the patterns, master the challenges, and get faster with every run.

name: MODIFY
short_description: Break into a machine by breaking its rules. Change what it is and how it thinks. Comes with a level editor, Workshop and mod support.

name: Moon and Away
short_description: A short, atmospheric, story-driven experience about a young woman searching for meaning in a world that no longer feels familiar.

name: Desktop Grass
short_description: Grow grass on your taskbar so you don't have to go outside and touch grass.

name: Lunch Break Dodgeball
short_description: Physics-driven online dodgeball for 2–24 players. Create a custom player from photos, join public or password-protected rooms, and practice offline in 12-vs-12 schoolyard or gym matches.

name: PuruPuru: Pull It Along
short_description: Grab squishy little Purupuru with your mouse, stre-e-etch, and climb. It clings to walls and ceilings like a dewdrop. When the thread snaps, off it flies. The bigger the pull, the bigger the jump. Fall and your height is gone, but there's no game over. Play Solo or 4-player online Delivery Climb.
